persistent_allocation_changes: KV cache BFP8 (was BF16): KV bytes per token per attention layer (K+V, 8 heads x 64) 1088 incl. block exponents (was 2048 in BF16)
expert weights held twice in BFP8: stacked [1,E,K,N] for decode sparse_matmul and per-expert (H,I)/(I,H) for prefill token dispatch
decode/prefill weights otherwise BFP8; DRAM-sharded projection weights replace (not add to) the interleaved copies

round 2: dense layers (0, 1) hold decode-only DRAM-sharded w1/w3 (N zero-padded 11776 -> 12288) and a K-padded decode w2 next to the prefill w1/w3/w2: ~77 MB BFP8 extra per dense layer (~0.15 GB for the model)
round 2: router as a DRAM-sharded [2048, 256] bf16 matmul (N zero-padded from 64): +0.75 MB per MoE layer; router K-split copy removed
round 2: compact-MoE constants (buckets 1/2/4) and SDPA bucket slices are a few KB; no KV-cache change

round 3: routing index constants (moe_route_v3) shared per device in DRAM (a few KB; L1 placement OOMs the hybrid prefill expert op); attention pad-free zero buffer copied per call from one shared DRAM zeros tensor
round 3: no weight or KV-cache size change (BFP4/LoFi candidates deferred to the datatype sweep)

persistent_allocation_changes: per chip: 1/4 of every attention / conv / dense weight, 1/4 of every expert in the decode stacked copy (TP over I) and 16 whole experts in the prefill dispatch copy (EP): same bytes per chip for both expert copies
per chip KV cache: 2 of 8 kv heads (1/4 of the single-chip cache)
replicated: norms, router (+ DS decode router), RoPE tables, routing / dispatch constants
l1_small_size 24576 (CCL semaphores); decode all-reduce scratch allocated per call (no persistent L1)
two all_reduce_async scratch buffers [32, 8192] bf16 width-sharded L1 per mesh, used alternately (2 x 64 KiB per core on the 8-core grid; L1 is allocated at one address in every bank)
attention concat output buffers in L1 per (bucket rows, layout), shared by the layers; moe_route_v3 index constants in L1 (shared); per-layer routing bias in DRAM
ShortConv state and expanded taps in DRAM (no per-layer L1); prefill dispatch: one zero BFP8 down projection [1536, 2048] per MoE layer per chip (3.3 MB)
dense layers: packed [w1 | w3] decode DS weight replaces the two per-projection decode copies (same bytes)
measured persistent L1 of the 40-layer stack: 160000 B per core at construction (0 per additional layer) + <= 24576 B of lazily allocated per-bucket attention concat buffers (<= 184576 B)
